시편-82-1.title: 시편 82장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-82-1.exegesis: 13-16. Obedience would have secured all promised blessings and the subjection of foes. In this passage, "should have," "would have," &c., are better, "should" and "would" expressing God's intention at the time, that is, when they left Egypt.
시편-82-1.theologicalNote: 13-16. Obedience would have secured all promised blessings and the subjection of foes. In this passage, "should have," "would have," &c., are better, "should" and "would" expressing God's intention at the time, that is, when they left Egypt.

시편-82-2.title: 시편 82장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-82-2.exegesis: PSALM 82 Psa 82:1-8 . Before the great Judge, the judges of the earth are rebuked, exhorted, and threatened. 1. congregation-- (Compare Ex 12:3 ; 16:1 ). of the mighty-- that is, of God, of His appointment. the gods-- or, "judges" ( Ex 21:6 ; 22:9 ), God's representatives.

시편-82-3.title: 시편 82장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-82-3.exegesis: 2. accept the persons-- literally, "lift up the faces," that is, from dejection, or admit to favor and communion, regardless of merit ( Le 19:15 ; Pr 18:5 ).
